meta.price_rule: Only verified usd_m2.headline from pvr-towns-aug2026.json. Do not invent listings.
meta.missing_axis_rule: If an axis has no town-level evidence, mark unknown and DROP it from the composite. Remaining weights renormalize to 100. Do not fill with regional stamps. A known empty future-catalyst catalog is scored 0 (evidence of no non-open catalyst), not unknown.
hard_gates: timezone within 3h of SF / NY / Miami

peers.median_rule: Median of PV 5 de Dic, Conchas Chinas, Sayulita, Punta Mita headlines. Four values → mean of the two middle.
peers.cabo_source: MLS BCS Médano median, 27 Aug 2026 — not Homia
peers.cabo_role: off-map ceiling only — not in the median, not scored as a PVR town

formulas.price_runway: clip(50 + 50 * (in_radius_peer_median - headline) / in_radius_peer_median, 0, 100). Headline ≥ Cabo ceiling → 0.

future_catalysts.assignment: Only towns[].catalysts plus hotel-pipeline rows with town_id. 'Near San Pancho/Sayulita' and PV-wide rumors are not assigned to a scored neighborhood.
future_catalysts.dispute: Brand-vs-press dispute does not change stage. No invented cancellation.

formulas.timezone_overlap: Uniform 90 for every town that passes the 3h gate.
formulas.composite: (sum score_i * weight_i) / sum(weights of in_composite axes), then round to nearest int.

not_used: NOAA 46-storm envelope as a per-town hurricane score
Pacific-vs-Caribbean sargassum as a per-town beach score
Thompson Puerto Vallarta (town_id null — not pinned to 5 de Dic / Amapas / Conchas)
meta.coverage_warning: v1 composite is partial: hurricane, safety, potable water, and beach/sargassum are unknown for every priced town (55 of 100 weight dropped). Do not present overall as a complete Coastal Grade.
